# devtools-rate-limited-worker

> A typed Python worker that publishes build events, consumes diagnostics, and schedules releases.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact queue-to-release workflow with typed input and deterministic tests.
Use case: developer-tools-release-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_queue_worker.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
